entries.citation: 742ebdf69 (SD_PATTERNS' featuring discount, no word boundary, Sept 2010); 7b59604c5 (partial fix, beets 2.13.0); 19d091440 (symmetric word-boundary fix, still unreleased at pinned 2.13.1)
entries.reproduced_reason: Reproduced by all six probe cases (Task 16). Each pairs two genuinely different strings that share a leading word ending in "ft" ("Draft", "Left", "Gift", "Soft", "Craft", "Theft"), so SD_PATTERNS' unbounded featuring trigger deletes the rest of both strings and charges the real difference at 0.1. Every case's derived recommendation is strong/apply; recomputed with a word boundary before the trigger, every case's distance lands past strong_rec_thresh (0.04) in the medium band, so all six move the verdict. Per case, derived against defect-free distance: adv-ft-draft-colon 0.010185 / 0.101852; adv-ft-left-colon 0.011765 / 0.117647; adv-ft-gift-space 0.010784 / 0.107843; adv-ft-soft-onesided 0.030095 / 0.086667; adv-ft-craft-titles 0.009171 / 0.091708; adv-ft-theft-artist 0.009091 / 0.090909. The six span the album, track_title, and artist components, both the symmetric and the one-sided firing, and all three members of the trigger's `[\. :]` separator class.
entries.reason: Six probe cases authored this pass (Task 16) reproduce the defect. 2b's strdist-feat-strip already proved the pipeline mechanics for the legitimate feat. strip, where the trigger really is a featuring credit; these are its false-positive twin, where the trigger is an ordinary English word. Disposition stays owner-only.

entries.reproduced_reason: Reproduced by all four probe cases (Task 16). Each pairs a release against its own remix or alternate version, with the only distinguishing token inside the 0.3-weight parenthetical (or its square-bracket twin), so the discount erases the differentiator. Every case's derived recommendation is strong/apply; recomputed with the parenthetical at full weight, every case lands past strong_rec_thresh (0.04) in the medium band. Per case, derived against defect-free distance: adv-remix-both-sides 0.024000 / 0.080000; adv-remix-onesided 0.021429 / 0.071429; adv-remix-bracket 0.027778 / 0.092593; adv-remix-track-titles 0.024561 / 0.081871. The four span both bracket patterns, the one-sided and both-sides firings, and the album and track_title components.
